alternatives.option: Rely on prompt hook alone for gate enforcement
alternatives.reason_rejected: Prompt content is transient — it doesn't survive context compression and has weaker authority than CLAUDE.md instructions. Agents in long sessions lose the gates.

alternatives.option: Inject the full CLAUDE_TEMPLATE.md (121 lines) instead of condensed gates
alternatives.reason_rejected: Too verbose for automatic injection into user's CLAUDE.md. The condensed version covers the 3 gates and critical rules; detailed workflow guidance belongs in docs/CLAUDE_TEMPLATE.md for manual adoption.

context: The SessionStart prompt hook provides transient gate instructions that don't survive context compression. CLAUDE.md has persistent authority — content there is loaded every session and survives compression. Adding a command hook that idempotently appends the gates section to CLAUDE.md gives the gates durable enforcement.
rationale: Shell script runs before the prompt hook, checks for marker string 'Twining Lifecycle Gates', appends condensed 3-gate section if absent. Pure bash, no dependencies, 5s timeout. Creates CLAUDE.md if it doesn't exist. The content is a condensed version of docs/CLAUDE_TEMPLATE.md covering just the mandatory gates and critical rules.
summary: Add SessionStart command hook to inject Twining Lifecycle Gates into project CLAUDE.md
